mentions.name: bcachefs SSD+HDD mixed-tier improvements
mentions.description: Work to improve bcachefs for setups that mix SSDs and HDDs in one filesystem, so foreground operations get SSD-class write latencies instead of being dragged down by the HDD, with the HDD relegated to background work.
mentions.problem: Even when the SSD is set up for foreground operations and the HDD only for background, write latencies usually end up matching the HDD's.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on making bcachefs useful when you mix both SSD and HDD in one filesystem.
mentions.author: eru
